description: This Java class 'ConsumerData' encapsulates data related to a JMS message consumer, including source information, addresses, and the message consumer instance itself. It provides constructors, getters, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: ConsumerData
classes.description: Immutable class representing a JMS message consumer's associated data, including source, address, and consumer instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ConsumerData instance with specified source, address, addressWithIndex, and MessageConsumer.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source associated with this consumer data.

methods.name: getAddressWithIndex
methods.description: Returns the address with index string.

methods.name: getActorNamePrefix
methods.description: Constructs and returns a string prefix for actor naming based on the source index and address with index.

methods.name: withMessageConsumer
methods.description: Returns a new ConsumerData instance with the specified MessageConsumer, keeping other fields the same.
